rate_personal_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
rate_personal_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
rate_personal_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports.
rate_personal_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

rate_medical_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
rate_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
N_enrolled.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

rate_utd.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for all required vaccines
rate_utd.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students up to date for every vaccine the state requires.
rate_utd.long_description: Share of assessed school students recorded as up to date across the full required schedule, rather than for a single antigen.
rate_utd.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for all required vaccines.

rate_conditional.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students admitted conditionally while completing required immunizations.
rate_conditional.long_description: Share of assessed school students who are conditionally (or provisionally) enrolled - permitted to attend while in the process of completing required immunizations and not yet overdue.
rate_conditional.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were conditionally enrolled.

rate_not_utd.long_name: Proportion of students not up to date for all required vaccines
rate_not_utd.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students not up to date for every vaccine the state requires.
rate_not_utd.long_description: Share of assessed school students not recorded as up to date across the full required schedule, excluding those conditionally enrolled.
rate_not_utd.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were not up to date for all required vaccines.

nh_school_immunization.name: New Hampshire School Immunization Data
nh_school_immunization.organization: New Hampshire Department of Health and Human Services
nh_school_immunization.description: County-level immunization status (up to date, conditional, exempt) from the annual NH DHHS school immunization reports.
nh_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
